बॉक्स ऑफिस पर उड़ता तीर ने मचाया गदर, पहले हफ्ते में ही पार किया तीस करोड़ का आंकड़ा! 🎟️🔥

आयुष्मान खुराना और सारा अली खान की स्पाई कॉमेडी फिल्म Udta Teer ने पहले हफ्ते में घरेलू बॉक्स ऑफिस पर ₹ 31.25 करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है।
फिल्म ने शुक्रवार 23 अक्टूबर को ₹ 4.10 करोड़ से ओपनिंग की थी, जिसके बाद शनिवार को कमाई बढ़कर ₹ 7.25 करोड़ और रविवार को ₹ 8.20 करोड़ हो गई थी।
Sacnilk की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक गुरुवार को फिल्म ने ₹ 2.60 करोड़ कमाए, जिसमें कोई गिरावट नहीं आई।
फिल्म को सिनेमाघरों में Rajinikanth की Jailer 2 के अलावा Nayyi Navelli और Prahaar जैसी फिल्मों से कड़ी टक्कर मिल रही है।
फिल्म की कहानी एक पाकिस्तानी जासूस के बारे में है जो धमाके में याददाश्त खोने के बाद खुद को इंडियन Counter-Terrorism Squad का अफसर समझने लगता है।
आयुष्मान ने बताया कि प्रोड्यूसर Guneet Monga ने उनका पहला ऑडिशन लिया था और दोनों की पसंद यूनीक सिनेमा की है।
क्या आपने सिनेमाघर में जाकर Udta Teer देख ली या नहीं? 🎬👇

ctx.title: Udta Teer box office collection day 7: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan film maintains momentum, crosses  ₹30 in its first week
ctx.summary: Udta Teer box office collection day 7: The spy comedy film also features Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, and late Mukul Dev in key roles.
ctx.text:
Udta Teer box office collection day 7: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s spy comedy Udta Teer has crossed the ₹ 30-crore mark at the domestic box office in its opening week, showing steady collections despite competition from other theatrical releases. The film, which opened to positive reviews, witnessed a strong jump over its first weekend before settling into weekday collections.
Udta Teer opened with ₹ 4.10 crore on Friday, October 23. Saturday brought a noticeable improvement, as collections rose to ₹ 7.25 crore, a jump of around 76% from the opening day. The upward trend continued on Sunday, when the film collected ₹ 8.20 crore. The latest update from Sacnilk states that the film managed to collect ₹ 2.60 crore on Thursday, which did not show a dip from its previous day haul. This brings the total box office collection of the film to ₹ 31.25 crore after its first week.
Udta Teer faced heat at the box office with the release of a mammoth film like Jailer 2 , starring Rajinikanth in the lead, just a week before. Nayyi Navelli and Prahaar were also giving competition to the spy comedy in theatres.
The film follows a Pakistani spy, played by Ayushmann, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.
Ayushmann recently opened up about working with producer Guneet Monga , pointing out that they have a similar approach to choosing stories. The actor said, “Guneet and I share a very common core when it comes to content. I've always been drawn to clutter-breaking, unique cinema, and Guneet has championed distinctive storytelling in her own way, taking Indian stories to a global platform and representing India at the Oscars. And it is this synergy that makes this film so exciting. With Udta Teer, we're bringing that shared vision to a genre-breaking entertainer that blends patriotism, action and comedy."
The film also brings the two together after a long association that began well before their current collaboration. Recalling their history, Ayushmann added, “She took my first ever audition, so we go back a long way. We've stayed in touch ever since and watched each other's journeys, and now we've finally got the chance to work together.”
